question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT ORDER_ID, ITEM_LINE_COUNT, ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), categorized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
      WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'More than one item line'
      ELSE 'Unknown item-line count'
    END AS ORDER_GROUP,
    ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM orders_2025
)
SELECT
  ORDER_GROUP,
  COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_2025), 0) AS SHARE_OF_2025_ORDERS,
  AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM categorized
GROUP BY ORDER_GROUP
ORDER BY CASE ORDER_GROUP WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1 WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2 WHEN 'More than one item line' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

action.answer: For recorded order dates in 2025, 3,052,089 of 4,359,773 orders contained more than one item line: 70.005700% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 units for the 1,307,684 one-line orders and 3.484769 units for the 3,052,089 multi-line orders. No orders with zero item lines were returned (0 orders; 0.000000%).
